decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed access ramp, by reason of its position on the adopted public highway, would result in an unacceptable trip hazard, which would be likely to result in harm to pedestrian safety, contrary to the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), S.4.4 (Access to Shopping Facilities) and T.2.2 (Pedestrian Safety and Security).

Condition : 2 - The proposed access ramp, by reason of its size, position and appearance, would represent an obtrusive and incongruous feature, which would be out of character with the shopping parade and would harm the appearance of the street scene, contrary to the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and S.4.2 (Shop Front Design).

Condition : 3 - Informative: In order to provide level access and Disability Discrimination Act compliance for this building, and in the interests of pedestrian safety, the Council would recommend that the owner consider making the alteration internally within the building.
description: Installation of a disabled persons access ramp to front entrance
